errors.evidence: The x-axis of the chart ends at 2021 Q4, not 2022 Q4.
The word "четиримесечни" means "four-month". Quarters ("тримесечие") are three-month periods.
The x-axis does not have labels for every quarter; the labels are for intermittent points in time (e.g., 2003Q1, 2004Q2, 2005Q3).
